outcome_record: 果登鄉榜，即於次歲辰年聯捷
雨至己酉日方霁。
果於早勝﹐午時又大敗破財。

Confirmed in the text: 'The Town was delivered for the Parliament's use the 27th of April... three days after the time limited by me was expired; but the very Monday before, being eight days after the Figure set, they began to treat.' Lilly adds the King's relief was beaten back at Caversham Bridge, the Governor (Aston) was hurt in the head (as Saturn in Pisces(?) afflicted by Mars denoted), and they did not want ammunition, as Venus in the 5th signified. See the year flag in inputs (1643 historically; OCR prints 1644).

outcome_record: Of the disease: 'all which was true'; of the event: 'The sick dyed the 28th of July following' — twelve days after the figure of 16 July 1645.
思宗因旱祈雨，壬戌日赦文武大臣七人，此公在赦内。后知为张逢玄先生也。十二年后，果历仕途显要，今为少冢宰，寻转大司空。
其人果死不还。
月内升天津巡抚，后以标官劫皇销事发，请告回里。
